TMC Faces Internal Strife Amidst Legal and Political Challenges

West Bengal's ruling Trinamool Congress (TMC) is experiencing significant internal conflict, with factions led by Mamata Banerjee and rebel leaders vying for control of the party. This crisis is unfolding against the backdrop of a controversial rape-murder case in Baruipur, which has sparked political accusations and protests. The Election Commission is set to hear claims regarding the party's name and symbol, intensifying the internal power struggle.
